messages.content: The schedule changed. Wednesday's team dinner is now mandatory, and Friday's closing meeting at the Carlsbad site ends at 3:30 p.m. Please redo both sides before I buy anything.
What time and location is the dinner? I also need to allow for the drive from SAN and any hotel stop before it.
It starts at 5:30 p.m. near the site, and I should be there by 5:15. I can go directly from the airport and check in afterward.

That eliminates both prior outbound choices. The 12:30 p.m. departure was scheduled into SAN around 2:10, which leaves little recovery time after deplaning and the drive north; the later flight cannot work. The practical nonstop choices are now approximately 8:15-9:50 a.m. and 10:05-11:40 a.m. The second still gives roughly three and a half hours to reach Carlsbad, so it is adequate if its live schedule is confirmed.
Use the 10:05 unless there is a material reason to take the first one. What does the earlier Friday finish change?

Leaving the site around 3:45 p.m., I would budget as much as 90 minutes to SAN in Friday traffic, then preserve normal check-in and security time. A 6:30 p.m. departure is technically possible but has little protection against a late meeting or a slow drive. A nonstop around 7:05 p.m. becomes workable; the prior 7:45 p.m. option remains more forgiving, while the 9:00 p.m. flight is no longer necessary for transfer margin.
Compare the 7:05 and 7:45 as an actual round trip. I do not want to save forty minutes by creating a fragile airport transfer.

The 10:05 a.m. Wednesday outbound paired with the 7:45 p.m. Friday return is the stronger booking choice. It gets you to SAN around 11:40 a.m., leaving substantial time for the mandatory 5:15 arrival in Carlsbad. On Friday, even a 90-minute drive puts you at SAN around 5:15, giving about two and a half hours before departure. The 7:05 saves only forty minutes and reduces that buffer to under two hours.
Select the 10:05 outbound and 7:45 return. What must be checked on the booking screen?

Select the Wednesday nonstop departing SFO at about 10:05 a.m. and the Friday nonstop departing SAN at about 7:45 p.m. Before payment, confirm the exact flight numbers and times, operating carriers, business-class inventory and fare, change or cancellation terms, and that both segments are on September 11 and 13. Also confirm the dinner address near the Carlsbad site and use a current Friday traffic estimate when arranging the airport ride. Nothing is booked until the final purchase is completed.
